title: 第0015章凰溪岛激战绝境中的曙光第0016章低语蚀心温泉诡影

一、初战诡异生物：困境突显
洞穴之中，诡异生物如汹涌潮水般涌来。才依依率先出手，她身形如电，气血之力化作凌厉的攻势，冲向最前方的几只诡异生物。那些生物看似凶猛，但在才依依强大的气血攻击下，瞬间被击飞，身体破碎，化作一滩滩黑色的黏液。
然而，诡异生物的数量实在太多，前赴后继，源源不断。贾黑米也鼓起勇气，凭借着「心灵破障」天赋，试图干扰这些生物的精神。他集中精神，发出微弱却独特的心灵波动，一些实力较弱的诡异生物受到干扰，动作变得迟缓，甚至出现短暂的混乱。
但很快，贾黑米就感到一阵头晕目眩。他本就气血不足，过度使用心灵天赋让他的精神力消耗极大，身体也开始摇摇欲坠。才依依见状，大声喊道：“贾黑米，别勉强自己，先退到后面！”
此时，花呗呗却在一旁饶有兴致地看着，并没有立刻出手的意思。她嘴里嘟囔着：“这些生物看起来挺有意思，不知道能和我交易些什么。”才依依听到她的话，又气又急：“花呗呗，现在都什么时候了，你还想着交易，先一起把这些怪物解决掉！”
花呗呗撇撇嘴：“别急嘛，我先观察观察。”就在她说话间，一只体型巨大、形似蜥蜴的诡异生物突破了才依依的防线，朝着贾黑米扑去。这蜥蜴状生物速度极快，贾黑米根本来不及躲避，眼看就要被击中。
千钧一发之际，猫和突然从旁边窜出，它身形矫健，灵活地跳到蜥蜴状生物的背上，锋利的爪子狠狠地抓进它的皮肤。蜥蜴状生物吃痛，疯狂地甩动身体，试图把猫和甩下去。猫和紧紧抓住，不断用爪子攻击，一时间，蜥蜴状生物身上鲜血淋漓。
才依依趁机调整攻击节奏，她凝聚气血之力，形成一道巨大的气血剑刃，朝着蜥蜴状生物斩去。气血剑刃势如破竹，直接将蜥蜴状生物斩成两段。黑色黏液四处飞溅，散发着刺鼻的气味。
但战斗并没有因此而缓和，更多的诡异生物涌了上来，将他们团团围住。这些生物似乎有着一定的智慧，它们开始改变战术，不再盲目冲锋，而是分成几个小组，从不同方向同时进攻，让才依依等人有些应接不暇。
二、花呗呗出手：神秘交易之力
才依依虽然实力强大，但在众多诡异生物的围攻下，也逐渐感到吃力。她的气血之力消耗巨大，动作也不如之前敏捷。贾黑米在一旁想要帮忙，却因为自身实力有限，只能偶尔干扰一下靠近的生物，无法对整体战局产生太大影响。
花呗呗看到局势越来越危急，终于决定出手。她嘴角微微上扬，露出一抹神秘的笑容，双手开始快速结印，口中念念有词。一道道奇异的光芒从她身上散发出来，笼罩了周围的诡异生物。
“嘿，小家伙们，我们来做个交易怎么样？”花呗呗的声音在洞穴中回荡，“只要你们放弃攻击，我可以给你们一些意想不到的好处。”
那些诡异生物似乎被花呗呗的话吸引，动作微微一顿。就在这时，花呗呗双手一挥，一些散发着微光的能量球出现在她手中。这些能量球散发着一种诱人的气息，让诡异生物们蠢蠢欲动。
“看，这就是我要和你们交易的东西。只要你们停止攻击，我就把这些能量球给你们。”花呗呗继续诱惑道。
部分诡异生物开始动摇，它们停止了攻击，眼睛紧紧盯着花呗呗手中的能量球。然而，还有一些强大的诡异生物似乎并不买账，它们发出低沉的咆哮声，继续朝着才依依等人冲来。
花呗呗皱了皱眉头，说道：“看来有些家伙不太听话呢。”她双手再次结印，一道道神秘的符文从她手中飞出，缠绕在那些不听话的诡异生物身上。被符文缠绕的生物突然痛苦地嚎叫起来，身体不受控制地颤抖着。
“现在，你们愿意交易了吗？”花呗呗冷冷地说道。那些强大的诡异生物在痛苦中挣扎了一会儿，最终还是屈服了。它们缓缓停下脚步，眼神中透露出一丝恐惧和渴望。
花呗呗满意地点点头，将手中的能量球抛向那些停止攻击的诡异生物。能量球在空中划过一道道弧线，落入生物群中。诡异生物们纷纷争抢着能量球，一时间，洞穴中的战斗暂时停了下来。

才依依和贾黑米都惊讶地看着花呗呗，没想到她竟然真的用交易的方式暂时化解了危机。才依依说道：“花呗呗，没想到你还真有两下子。”花呗呗得意地笑了笑：“那是当然，我花呗呗出手，就没有办不成的事。”
三、深入洞穴：神秘遗迹现
然而，平静只是暂时的。那些得到能量球的诡异生物在吸收能量后，似乎变得更加强大，而且它们并没有真正放弃攻击的意图，只是暂时被能量球吸引。才依依意识到，必须尽快找到离开这个洞穴的方法，或者彻底解决这些诡异生物的源头。
猫和似乎察觉到了才依依的想法，它朝着洞穴的更深处喵喵叫了几声，然后转身跑了进去。才依依说道：“猫和好像发现了什么，我们跟上去看看。”贾黑米和花呗呗点了点头，三人小心翼翼地跟在猫和后面。
他们沿着洞穴的通道继续前行，通道越来越狭窄，光线也越来越昏暗。周围的墙壁上刻满了各种奇怪的符号和图案，与之前在洞穴中看到的有些相似，但又更加复杂和神秘。
突然，前方出现了一道巨大的石门。石门上雕刻着精美的图案，似乎描绘着一个古老的仪式。才依依走上前去，仔细观察石门上的图案，试图找到打开石门的方法。
贾黑米也在一旁帮忙，他运用「心灵破障」天赋，试图感知石门上是否存在某种精神层面的机关。就在他集中精神的时候，突然感觉到一股强大的精神力量从石门中传来，这股力量试图侵入他的意识。
贾黑米脸色一变，连忙收回精神力，身体摇晃了几下。才依依赶紧扶住他，问道：“你怎么了？”贾黑米喘着粗气说道：“石门里有强大的精神力量，想要侵入我的意识。”
才依依皱了皱眉头，说道：“看来这石门不简单，我们不能贸然打开。”花呗呗却在一旁说道：“怕什么，让我来试试。”她走上前去，双手放在石门上，闭上眼睛，似乎在和石门进行某种交流。
过了一会儿，花呗呗睁开眼睛，脸上露出惊喜的神色：“有意思，这石门后面似乎有一个古老的遗迹，里面藏着很多好东西。而且，我和这石门达成了一个交易，只要我们提供足够的精神力量，它就会打开。”
才依依和贾黑米都惊讶地看着她，才依依说道：“提供精神力量？这太危险了，我们不知道后面会发生什么。”花呗呗却满不在乎地说道：“富贵险中求，不冒险怎么能有收获呢？而且，我有办法控制精神力量的输出，不会让你们有太大危险的。”
在花呗呗的劝说下，才依依和贾黑米最终还是同意了。他们按照花呗呗的指示，将手放在石门上，集中精神，输出精神力量。随着精神力量的不断输入，石门上的图案开始闪烁起光芒，发出阵阵嗡嗡声。
四、遗迹危机：诡异守护者
终于，在一阵强烈的光芒闪烁后，石门缓缓打开。一股古老而神秘的气息扑面而来，让三人都不禁打了个寒颤。他们小心翼翼地走进遗迹，里面是一个巨大的圆形大厅，四周的墙壁上镶嵌着各种发光的宝石，照亮了整个空间。

1. The first battle with strange creatures: the dilemma is highlighted
In the cave, strange creatures surged in like a raging tide. Cai Yiyi was the first to take action. Her body was like electricity, and the power of her energy and blood turned into a fierce offensive, rushing towards the strange creatures at the front. Those creatures looked ferocious, but under Cai Yiyi's powerful energy and blood attack, they were instantly knocked away, their bodies shattered, and turned into pools of black mucus.
However, there are too many strange creatures, and they come one after another in an endless stream. Jiahemi also plucked up the courage and relied on his "Psychic Barrier Breaking" talent to try to interfere with the spirits of these creatures. He concentrated and sent out weak but unique mental fluctuations. Some weak and strange creatures were disturbed, and their movements became sluggish, and even briefly confused.
But soon, Jahimi felt dizzy. He was already low on vitality and blood, and excessive use of his psychic talent consumed his mental energy greatly, and his body began to collapse. Cai Yiyi saw this and shouted loudly: "Jia Heimi, don't force yourself, step back first!"
At this time, Hua Beibei was watching with interest and had no intention of taking action immediately. She muttered: "These creatures look interesting, I wonder what they can trade with me." Cai Yiyi heard her words and was angry and anxious: "Hua Bei Bei, what time is it now, and you still want to trade, let's get rid of these monsters together first!"
Hua Beibei curled her lips: "Don't worry, I'll observe first." As she was speaking, a huge, lizard-like strange creature broke through Cai Yiyi's defense and rushed towards Jia Heimi. This lizard-like creature was so fast that Jahimi had no time to dodge and was about to be hit.
At the critical moment, Mao He suddenly jumped out from the side. It was strong and agile, jumped onto the back of the lizard-like creature, and clawed its sharp claws into its skin. The lizard-like creature was in pain and shook its body wildly, trying to throw the cat off. Cat He held on tightly and kept attacking with his claws. For a while, the lizard-like creature was dripping with blood.
Cai Yiyi took the opportunity to adjust the rhythm of her attack. She gathered the power of her energy and blood to form a huge sword of energy and blood, and slashed at the lizard-like creature. The energy-blood sword blade was as powerful as breaking bamboo, directly cutting the lizard-like creature into two pieces. Black slime splattered everywhere, exuding a pungent smell.
But the battle did not ease. More strange creatures came up and surrounded them. These creatures seemed to have a certain degree of intelligence. They began to change their tactics and no longer charged blindly. Instead, they divided into several groups and attacked from different directions at the same time, leaving Cai Yiyi and others overwhelmed.
2. Huabebei takes action: the power of mysterious transactions
Although Cai Yiyi was powerful, she gradually felt overwhelmed by the siege of many strange creatures. Her energy and blood energy was consumed greatly, and her movements were not as agile as before. Jia Heimi wanted to help, but due to his limited strength, he could only occasionally interfere with the approaching creatures and could not have much impact on the overall battle situation.
Seeing that the situation was getting more and more critical, Hua Beibei finally decided to take action. The corners of her mouth raised slightly, revealing a mysterious smile. She quickly began to form seals with her hands and muttered words. Strange rays of light emanated from her body, covering the strange creatures around her.
"Hey, little guys, how about we make a deal?" Hua Beibei's voice echoed in the cave, "As long as you give up attacking, I can give you some unexpected benefits."
Those strange creatures seemed to be attracted by Hua Beibei's words, and their movements paused slightly. At this moment, Hua Beibei waved her hands, and some shimmering energy balls appeared in her hands. These energy balls exude an alluring aura, making the strange creatures ready to move.
"Look, this is what I want to trade with you. As long as you stop attacking, I will give you these energy balls." Hua Beibei continued to seduce.
partThe strange creatures began to waver, they stopped attacking, and their eyes were fixed on the energy ball in Hua Beibei's hand. However, there were some powerful and strange creatures that didn't seem to buy it. They made low roars and continued to rush towards Cai Yiyi and others.
Hua Beibei frowned and said, "It seems that some guys are not very obedient." She formed a seal with her hands again, and mysterious runes flew out of her hands and wrapped around those strange and disobedient creatures. The creature entangled by the runes suddenly howled in pain, its body shaking uncontrollably.
"Now, are you willing to trade?" Hua Beibei said coldly. Those powerful and strange creatures struggled in pain for a while, and finally succumbed. They stopped slowly, with a hint of fear and desire in their eyes.
Hua Beibei nodded with satisfaction and threw the energy ball in his hand towards the strange creatures that stopped attacking. The energy balls drew arcs in the air and fell into the group of creatures. The strange creatures were fighting for the energy balls, and for a while, the fighting in the cave stopped temporarily.
Cai Yiyi and Jia Heimi both looked at Huabei Bei in surprise. They didn't expect that she actually used a transaction to temporarily resolve the crisis. Cai Yiyi said: "Hua Bei Bei, I didn't expect you to be really capable." Hua Bei Bei smiled proudly: "Of course, there is nothing I can't do if I take action."
3. Going deep into the cave: mysterious ruins revealed
However, the calm is only temporary. The strange creatures that got the energy balls seemed to become more powerful after absorbing the energy, and they did not really give up the intention of attacking, they were just temporarily attracted by the energy balls. Cai Yiyi realized that she must find a way out of the cave as soon as possible, or completely solve the source of these strange creatures.
Mao He seemed to be aware of Cai Yiyi's thoughts. It meowed a few times deeper into the cave, then turned and ran in. Cai Yiyi said: "Mao He seems to have discovered something, let's follow up and have a look." Jia Heimi and Hua Beibei nodded, and the three of them followed Mao He cautiously.
They continued along the passage of the cave, which became increasingly narrow and dim. The surrounding walls are engraved with various strange symbols and patterns, which are somewhat similar to those seen in the cave before, but more complex and mysterious.
Suddenly, a huge stone door appeared in front of him. The stone door is carved with exquisite patterns that seem to depict an ancient ritual. Cai Yiyi stepped forward and carefully observed the patterns on the stone door, trying to find a way to open the stone door.
Jia Heimi was also helping. He used his "Psychic Barrier Breaking" talent to try to sense whether there was some kind of spiritual mechanism on the stone door. Just when he was concentrating, he suddenly felt a powerful spiritual force coming from the stone door, and this force tried to invade his consciousness.
Jia Heimi's expression changed, he quickly withdrew his mental power and shook his body a few times. Cai Yiyi quickly supported him and asked, "What's wrong with you?" Jia Heimi gasped and said, "There is a powerful spiritual power in the stone gate that wants to invade my consciousness."
Cai Yiyi frowned and said, "It seems that this stone gate is not simple. We can't open it rashly." Hua Beibei said from the side: "What are you afraid of? Let me try." She walked forward, put her hands on the stone gate, closed her eyes, and seemed to be having some kind of communication with the stone gate.
After a while, Hua Beibei opened her eyes with a look of surprise on her face: "Interesting, there seems to be an ancient ruins behind this stone door, and there are many good things hidden inside. Moreover, I have reached a deal with this stone door. As long as we provide enough spiritual power, it will open."
Cai Yiyi and Jia Heimi both looked at her in surprise. Cai Yiyi said: "Providing spiritual power? This is too dangerous. We don't know what will happen next." Hua Beibei said nonchalantly: "FuYou gain something from risk. How can you gain something if you don’t take risks? Moreover, I have a way to control the output of mental power so that you will not be in too much danger. "
After Hua Beibei's persuasion, Cai Yiyi and Jia Heimi finally agreed. Following Hua Beibei's instructions, they put their hands on the stone door, concentrated on it, and output their spiritual power. With the continuous input of spiritual power, the patterns on the stone door began to shine and make a buzzing sound.
4. Ruins Crisis: Strange Guardian
Finally, after a strong flash of light, the stone door slowly opened. An ancient and mysterious aura hit their faces, making the three of them shiver. They carefully walked into the ruins. Inside was a huge rotunda, with various luminous gems inlaid on the surrounding walls, illuminating the entire space.
